column1: # Kanji mnemonic phrases, laid over KANJIDIC at lookup time.
# <kanji><TAB><phrase>. Written with Claude Code (kanji-mnemonics skill), then
# reviewed and edited by hand. Delete a line to regenerate it.

column2: A heart torn between this or that: perplexed.
A window with the sun framed inside: sun, day.
A single flat stroke, one finger held sideways: one.
A jewel kept safe inside a box: a country guarding its treasure.
People gather under one roof to say things: a meeting.
Two legs walking, leaning on each other: person.
A slash across the drying rack, one harvest dried each: year.
A person stretching arms and legs wide: big.
Two strokes crossing like a plus sign, ten fingers crossed: ten.
Two flat strokes, one above the other: two.
A tree with a mark at its root: origin, and a main book.
A rod piercing a mouth right through the middle: inside, middle.
Long hair flowing down from an elder's head: long, and the leader.
A mountain sprouting out of an open box: go out, exit.
Three flat strokes stacked like three ones: three.
One mouth in the same frame as everyone: same.
The sun moves over a Buddhist temple's bell: time, hour.
Striking things until they are correct: politics, government.
A mouth and a pig's head skewered on a barbed stick: a matter to handle.
A nose pointing at oneself: oneself.
Two crossroads halves, the path ahead: going, carry out.
An altar set on the soil: a shrine, now a company.
An eye on top of walking legs: see.
A crescent moon with two lines of shadow: moon, month.
A knife cuts a thing into eight: divide, part, minute.
Saying words about righteousness: deliberation, debate.
Step by step on short thread and walking legs, arriving late: behind, after.
Eight on a moon, a knife standing at the front: before, in front.
An eye pierced, the old mark of subjects: people of a nation.
A sprout pushing up out of the earth: life, birth.
A car walking the road, taking others along: connect, take along.
Two lines with a crossing between them, five on the abacus: five.
Footsteps on two legs dash off: depart, discharge.
The sun shining through the gap in a gate: interval, space.
A sentence weighed against a small measure: opposite, versus.
A divining rod standing up on one line: above, up.
Spitting out orders to the right village: a section, department.
The sun rising behind a tree: east.
An old man under the sun: someone, a person.
Esteem for the elder brother who leads: a political party.
Soil that simply is, to be the ground: earth, ground.
A person puts the one lid on a mouth: fit, join.
A cloth stall under a lid of an awning: market, city.
Sheep and trees stacked on a rack: business, work.
A person stepping inside the frame: inside.
A tree eyeing a tree, eye to eye: mutual, together.
A plough pointing one way: direction.
Legs inside a box, four corners: four.
Every head counted under the roof: settled, decide.
A person under one roof, right here: now.
A mouth inside a box, going round and round: revolve, times.
Stand by the tree and swing the axe for fresh wood: new.
The sun opens up over the soil: a place.
Nuggets buried under a roof in the earth: gold, money.
A mouth counting shellfish coins: a member, an employee.
A slash with a strange hook bending away: nine.
A person bending to walk in: enter.
Walking the road to the southeast to choose: elect, select.
A person standing on the ground: stand up.
A gate pushed wide open: open.
A palm with fingers and wrist: hand.
Grains scattered from a cross-shaped stalk: rice.
A flexed arm: power, strength.
A child under a sparkling cover, learning: study.
A mouth asking at the gate: question.
Lid, mouth and border stacked into a tower: tall, high.
A person swaps in for the ceremony: substitute, generation.
Sun and moon side by side: bright.
Many fruits stored under the roof: fruit, reality.
A coin's circle with a bar across: yen, circle.
Gate and frontier pass together: a barrier, connection.
Water bursts the dam once decided: decide.
A baby with arms out, wrapped in cloth: child.
Heavy things need power: move.
A tall house with a lid roof on little legs: capital.
A person crowned king over everything: whole, all.
An eye turned upright: eye.
Garments with two lines on the surface: surface, chart.
A single halberd against many: war, battle.
Holy thread running through the sutra: pass through, sutra.
Walking along a road with walls on both sides: pass through.
Divining in the evening, outside the house: outside.
Take the most under the sun: utmost, most.
A mouth with sound lines rising out: say, word.
A drooping family root: clan, surname.
The king sees it appear: present, actual.
The king lays out the village in order: logic, reason.
Say words all around the circumference: tune, investigate.
A person with a main frame: body.
A person turns into a spoon: change, transform.
A rice field divided into four plots: rice field.
Little drops hit the pig's head: hit, right on.
Two strokes parting away: eight.
A lid set on eight legs: six.
Thread tied around a ladle: a promise, approximately.
A drop of light above the king: lord, master.
This is right on page one: topic, title.
A divining rod hanging below one line: below, down.
Hair sprouting over an eye: head, neck.
The sound of the heart: idea, intention.
Water flowing gone downhill, as it must: law, method.
One line and a slash block the rod from growing: not, un-.
A rice plant arriving with the harvest: come.
A person working while making: make, build.
A heart you are born with: nature, gender.
A white circle with a ladle-shaped dot: bull's-eye, target.
A woman under the west cover, holding the waist: need, essence.
A fence used for something: use.
Cow and cloth cut to measure with a knife: system, control.
Water calmed on a pedestal: govern, cure.
Twenty steps, again and again, under the shelter: degree, times.
Halberd, striking and power: duties, task.
A bow strung with an insect's myself grip: strong.
Steam rising, cut through: spirit, air.
One small stroke with two little drops: small.
A one cut by a strange hooked stroke: seven.
Wrapping a halberd, it turns into a weapon: become.
That moon, marked on the calendar: period, term.
Eight hands sharing what was mine: public.
A hand holding the temple bell: hold.
A village stretching out before me: field, plains.
Ten join forces: cooperate.
A hand grabs an ear: take.
People gathered in a village: metropolis.
Grain in every mouth: peace, harmony.
Thread fills the loom as one: unify, govern.
A drop beside a person, by means of it: by means of.
How many trees make a loom: machine.
A flat scale balanced evenly: flat, peace.
Threads rushing together into one: overall, whole.
Power plus a mouth to cheer: add.
Three peaks rising: mountain.
A heart over the rice field, thinking: think.
A pig under the roof: house, home.
Say words with the tongue: talk.
Three tens joined, thirty years: a generation, the world.
A claw reaches under the cover to grab again: receive.
Grass cut and kept in a box: ward, district.
Orders written on a page: territory, jurisdiction.
Evening after evening: many.
An eye on the little things: prefecture.
Thread sold by the length: continue.
A bird walks the road forward, never back: advance.
One line stops you right there: correct.
A woman safe under the roof: peaceful.
Words and a weapon set up: establish.
A person shocked into protecting: protect, keep.
Strike oneself to change: reform.
Strike each one to count: number.
Say your self down on paper: record, account.
A hill with a completed temple on it: institution.
Saying words about one's own self: language.
A person leaning against a tree: rest.
Strength in the rice field: male.
A woman holding her child: fondness.
A tree next to a grove: forest.
A person standing by their word: trust.
A knife cutting the horn off a cow: take apart, solve.
A habit pierces the heart until it feels natural: accustomed.
